hostile-autofit-flood.why: 20,000 paragraphs in a shrink-on-overflow text box whose font scale is 1000%.

hostile-deep-groups.why: 5,000 nested groups, each halving its children, past the nesting depth a part may have.

hostile-deflate-bomb.why: The main part inflates to 300 MiB of white space from 300 KiB, past the size one part may inflate to: refused before it is read.

hostile-deflate-bomb-lying.why: The same bomb whose headers declare 1 KiB: the read stops past the declared size. Only one slide cannot be read: it is left out and the rest converts, as a slide a relationship names but the package lacks is.

hostile-deflate-bomb-parts.why: Every XML part inflates to 120 MiB, under the cap on one part: together they pass what one package may inflate to.

hostile-fuzz-1.why: The main part with bytes flipped, deleted and repeated from a fixed seed: any end but a crash or a panic.

hostile-fuzz-2.why: The main part with bytes flipped, deleted and repeated from a fixed seed: any end but a crash or a panic.

hostile-fuzz-3.why: The main part with bytes flipped, deleted and repeated from a fixed seed: any end but a crash or a panic.

hostile-fuzz-4.why: The main part with bytes flipped, deleted and repeated from a fixed seed: any end but a crash or a panic.

hostile-fuzz-5.why: The main part with bytes flipped, deleted and repeated from a fixed seed: any end but a crash or a panic.

hostile-fuzz-6.why: The main part with bytes flipped, deleted and repeated from a fixed seed: any end but a crash or a panic.

hostile-fuzz-7.why: The main part with bytes flipped, deleted and repeated from a fixed seed: any end but a crash or a panic.

hostile-fuzz-8.why: The main part with bytes flipped, deleted and repeated from a fixed seed: any end but a crash or a panic.

hostile-huge-slide-size.why: A slide 2^31 - 1 EMU wide and 1 tall, shapes offset and sized at the int64 bounds, negative sizes and a rotation of 2^31 - 1.

hostile-image-corrupt.why: A truncated PNG, a PNG with a bad CRC, a JPEG of garbage, an empty file, a JPEG named .png and a missing part: each picture is dropped, the rest converts.

hostile-image-pixel-bombs.why: A PNG of 100,000 by 100,000 pixels, a JPEG and a GIF of 65,535 square, a PNG 2^31 pixels tall, each a few bytes: dropped, never decoded at their declared size.

hostile-layout-cycle.why: The layout's master is the layout itself and the master's layouts are the master itself.

hostile-long-word.why: One run of 50 MiB of letters with no break opportunity: its part inflates past 600 times its compressed size, a deflate bomb's ratio, and is refused before it is inflated.

hostile-no-content-types.why: No [Content_Types].xml, which every package holds (ECMA-376 Part 2, 10.1.2.1).

hostile-no-main-part.why: The first slide is named but missing: left out, the rest converts.

hostile-overlap-bomb.why: 64 pictures whose entries overlap one stored stream of 100 MiB (Fifield, "A better zip bomb"): 6.4 GiB inflated from 120 KiB. Pictures past the package budget may be dropped or the document refused, within the memory bound, which leaves room for how far its peak varies between runs.

hostile-path-flood.why: One custom geometry of 500,000 segments: the process peaks near 430 MiB.

hostile-rels-cycle.why: Pictures whose relationships target the main part itself, its relationships part and [Content_Types].xml: not images, dropped.

hostile-rels-external.why: Pictures linked to file:///etc/passwd, a loopback URL, a UNC path and a relative path climbing out of the package: nothing outside the package is read or fetched.

hostile-shape-flood.why: 100,000 shapes on one slide, 16,384 drawn: the process peaks near 400 MiB.

hostile-slide-flood.why: 10,001 more slides naming one slide part, past the pages one conversion may have.

hostile-strict-namespaces.why: Every Transitional namespace and relationship type rewritten to its Strict one (ISO/IEC 29500-1, Annex A): a conforming Strict document.

hostile-table-huge.why: A table of 200 by 200 cells whose first spans 2^31 - 1 columns and rows.

hostile-xml-billion-laughs.why: Nine nested entities expanding to 10^9 "lol" (the billion laughs). OOXML parts carry no document type declaration, so the part is refused, never expanded. The slide is left out.

hostile-xml-deep-nesting.why: A million nested elements in the main part, past the nesting depth a part may have.

hostile-xml-external-entity.why: An external entity naming file:///etc/passwd: refused with its document type declaration, never resolved. The slide is left out.

hostile-xml-garbage.why: The main part is 4 KiB of random bytes. Only one slide cannot be read: it is left out and the rest converts, as a slide a relationship names but the package lacks is.

hostile-xml-unclosed.why: The main part stops two thirds in. Only one slide cannot be read: it is left out and the rest converts, as a slide a relationship names but the package lacks is.

hostile-xml-utf16.why: The main part in UTF-16 with a byte order mark, which every XML processor reads (XML 1.0, 4.3.3).

hostile-zip-bad-crc.why: The main part fails its CRC-32 (APPNOTE.TXT, 4.4.7). Only one slide cannot be read: it is left out and the rest converts, as a slide a relationship names but the package lacks is.

hostile-zip-duplicate-entry.why: Two entries share the main part's name, the second broken: readers that pick different ones disagree on the document, so it is refused (ECMA-376 Part 2, 8.2.2: part names are unique).

hostile-zip-empty.why: An empty file is no zip package (ECMA-376 Part 2, 8).

hostile-zip-encrypted-entry.why: The main part is flagged as PKWARE-encrypted but holds plain deflate: a reader may refuse the flag or read the data. Any end but a crash.

hostile-zip-entry-flood.why: 70,000 empty entries, past the entries a package may have.

hostile-zip-lying-size.why: The main part inflates past the size its headers declare. Only one slide cannot be read: it is left out and the rest converts, as a slide a relationship names but the package lacks is.

hostile-zip-not-zip.why: Plain text is no zip package.

hostile-zip-path-names.why: Entries named ../escape.xml, /absolute.xml, a backslash path, a drive letter and a NUL byte: invalid part names nothing references, ignored.

hostile-zip-prepended.why: A PDF header precedes the zip package: a polyglot. The package must start the file, where its local header signature is sniffed.

hostile-zip-truncated.why: Half a package: the central directory is gone.

hostile-zip-unsupported-method.why: The main part is stored with bzip2, which no OPC reader needs (ECMA-376 Part 2, 8.4.2 allows STORED and DEFLATED). Only one slide cannot be read: it is left out and the rest converts, as a slide a relationship names but the package lacks is.
